title: College-outcomes-explorer (College Scorecard) — not a ranking, not advice
context: The US Department of Education College Scorecard publishes institution-level outcome data (graduation rates, typical earnings, net cost) in a format inaccessible to most families and school counsellors. An explorer that presents affordability and outcomes without a single composite ranking or causal claim helps students and families explore options — but must explicitly state it is information, not advice, and must not imply that earnings are caused by the institution attended.
objective: Build a college-outcomes-explorer (College Scorecard, US Dept. of Education) — institution-level only, no person-level data, no composite ranking, no causal claims, explicitly not advice — passing all required gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate-003 PASS: College Scorecard = US government public domain; output CC-BY-4.0; institution-level data only, no person-level data; committed gate artifact.

Presents affordability and outcomes without a single composite 'best' ranking and without causal claims (earnings are not caused by the institution attended); explicit 'not advice' + data limits displayed prominently.
Methodology Card states the data dictionary version, transforms, vintage, and an explicit 'does NOT claim' list (no ranking-as-advice, no causation).
Methodology+Stats reviewer and Domain (college-access practitioner) sign-offs obtained; accessibility pass (WCAG 2.2 AA, reading grade <= 8) signed off.
Figures reproduce in CI from committed code + College Scorecard snapshot; built on the shared toolkit (toolkit-002).
resources: PLAN.md — Data, licensing & compliance (College Scorecard row)
output: A college-outcomes-explorer (committed static tool + plain-language content + Methodology Card + gate artifact + accessibility sign-off).
